steps.observation: As described before one crucial issue that we are trying to tackle in this work is that the given dataset is imbalanced. Particularly, there are only a few instances from indirect and physical harassment categories respectively in the train set, while there are much more in the validation and test sets for these categories. To tackle this issue we applying a back-translation method BIBREF13, where we translate indirect and physical harassment tweets of the train set from english to german, french and greek. After that, we translate them back to english in order to achieve data augmentation. These "noisy" data that have been translated back, increase the number of indirect and physical harassment tweets and boost significantly the performance of our models. Another way to enrich our models is the use of pre-trained word embeddings from 2B Twitter data BIBREF14 having 27B tokens, for the initialization of the embedding layer.
